string-array.name: ob_bodies
string-array.item: The Rovatics lab went dark and the robots fell asleep! Wake every robot with exactly the colour of light it needs.
Place mirrors and splitters on the grid to steer the laser. Tap a piece again to rotate it.
Tinted glass filters light, and beams of different colours mix: red and green make yellow.
Finish the 12 levels, then try the Daily Lab: a brand-new puzzle every day, the same for everyone.

string-array.name: about_bodies
string-array.item: Rovatics Beam Bots is a laser puzzle. Every sleeping robot needs light of one exact colour. Place mirrors and splitters to guide the beams and wake them all, using as few moves as you can.

• 12 levels that teach splitters, tinted glass and colour mixing
• A brand-new Daily Lab puzzle every day
• 3 hints per level and unlimited undo
• 1–3 star ratings
• Glowing beams, waking robots, celebrations, sound and haptics (all can be muted)
• Free, with no ads and no account

1. Choose a tool: mirror, splitter or eraser.
2. Tap the board to place it. Tap a piece to rotate it.
3. Beams stop at walls. Tinted glass lets only its own colour through.
4. Wake every robot with exactly the colour on its ring.
Light mixes like real light: red + green = yellow, red + blue = magenta, green + blue = cyan, and all three = white.
